zh-CN.title: 前滩的 Café，先从吧台看起。
zh-CN.dek: 为上海前滩太古里 Vivienne Westwood 新店开业拍摄 Café 空间、品牌标识与陈设细节，记录咖啡吧台及英伦街景主题装置。

en.title: A closer look at the Café in Qiantan.
en.dek: Photography for the opening of Vivienne Westwood at Taikoo Li Qiantan in Shanghai, documenting the Café counter, branding, display details and British streetscape installation.

zh-CN.text: 这次前滩太古里新店开业拍摄，我把 Vivienne Westwood Café 单独整理成一组。先看咖啡吧台，再看标识、菜单和台面上的用品。把这些放在一起，才看得清这间 Café 的具体样子。

en.text: For the new-store opening at Taikoo Li Qiantan, I have given the Vivienne Westwood Café its own series. The sequence starts with the counter, then moves to signage, menus and counter accessories. Together, these views describe the Café at different scales.

zh-CN.caption: Vivienne Westwood Café｜前滩太古里开业

en.caption: Vivienne Westwood Café — Opening at Taikoo Li Qiantan

zh-CN.text: 红色电话亭、邮筒和巴士站主题陈设，把英伦街景带进了店内。它们有很强的识别度，但这组照片也留下了吧台本身：咖啡店不只有适合拍照的装置，还有点单、制作和陈列的空间。

en.text: A red telephone box, postbox and bus-stop installation bring a British street setting into the store. They are distinctive elements, but the counter remains part of the story too: the Café is also a space arranged around ordering, preparation and display.

zh-CN.caption: Vivienne Westwood Café｜前滩太古里开业

en.caption: Vivienne Westwood Café — Opening at Taikoo Li Qiantan

zh-CN.text: 这套开业照片里还有店铺空镜和产品静物。我选择把三个主题拆开，让读者能分别看空间、Café 和柜内产品；它们来自同一次拍摄，放回一起也能串起完整的新店记录。

en.text: The same shoot includes retail interiors and product still lifes. I have separated the three subjects so each can be viewed in its own right. Read together, they make a fuller record of the new store.

zh-CN.caption: Vivienne Westwood Café｜前滩太古里开业

en.caption: Vivienne Westwood Café — Opening at Taikoo Li Qiantan

zh-CN.title: 走进前滩新店。
zh-CN.dek: 为上海前滩太古里 Vivienne Westwood 新店拍摄店铺空镜，以门头、室内全景、休息区与陈列细节呈现零售空间。

en.title: Inside the new Qiantan store.
en.dek: Retail space photography of the new Vivienne Westwood store at Taikoo Li Qiantan in Shanghai, covering the storefront, interior views, seating area and merchandise displays.

zh-CN.text: 这一篇接着前滩 Café，往店铺里面走。门头交代入口，室内全景交代柜台、通道和陈列的位置。我把这些画面留在一组里，方便先理解空间，再看里面的东西。

en.text: This series continues beyond the Qiantan Café into the retail space. The storefront establishes the entrance; wider interior views show the counters, circulation and displays. I have kept these photographs together so the layout can be understood before its details.

zh-CN.caption: Vivienne Westwood｜前滩太古里店铺空镜

en.caption: Vivienne Westwood — Store Interiors at Taikoo Li Qiantan

zh-CN.text: 弧形展示柜、镜面墙体和沙发休息区，是这套空镜里的几个重点。镜面会把陈列和空间重复带进画面，柜台的弧线又改变了观看方向。全景和局部各有用途，不能只用一种距离看完整间店。

en.text: Curved display counters, mirrored walls and the seating area are key parts of the series. Mirrors repeat the displays and the room, while the curves of the counters change the viewing direction. Wider frames and closer details describe different aspects of the interior.

zh-CN.caption: Vivienne Westwood｜前滩太古里店铺空镜

en.caption: Vivienne Westwood — Store Interiors at Taikoo Li Qiantan

zh-CN.text: 服装、包袋、眼镜、围巾和腰带都在各自的陈列位置上。这篇保留它们与店铺的关系，珠宝和腕表则另放进产品篇。这样看空镜的时候，视线不会总被某一件产品带走。

en.text: Clothing, bags, eyewear, scarves and belts appear in their display settings. This article keeps those relationships with the room intact, while jewellery and watches receive a separate product story.

zh-CN.caption: Vivienne Westwood｜前滩太古里店铺空镜

en.caption: Vivienne Westwood — Store Interiors at Taikoo Li Qiantan

zh-CN.title: 柜台里的 Orb、珍珠与腕表。
zh-CN.dek: 在上海前滩太古里 Vivienne Westwood 新店开业拍摄中，以柜内静物和局部特写记录珠宝、珍珠饰品与腕表的陈列细节。

en.title: Orb motifs, pearls and watches in the display case.
en.dek: Still-life and detail photography of jewellery, pearl accessories and watches, photographed in display cases for the opening of Vivienne Westwood at Taikoo Li Qiantan in Shanghai.

zh-CN.text: 前滩新店开业的第三个主题，是珠宝与腕表。这组是在现场展示柜里完成的静物摄影。我把组合陈列、俯拍和单件特写放在一起，既交代产品的排列，也留下每件东西的细节。

en.text: Jewellery and watches form the third part of the Qiantan store-opening shoot. These still lifes were photographed in the display cases. Collection views, overhead compositions and individual close-ups show both the arrangements and the details of each piece.

zh-CN.caption: Vivienne Westwood｜珠宝与腕表静物摄影

en.caption: Vivienne Westwood — Jewellery and Watch Still Life

zh-CN.text: Orb 标识、珍珠饰品、表盘和金属表带，各自需要不同的观看距离。整柜画面能看出系列，近一点才看得见标识、轮廓和材质。玻璃反射与柜内灯光也留在照片里，说明它们当时是怎样被展示的。

en.text: Orb motifs, pearl accessories, watch dials and metal bracelets invite different viewing distances. Collection frames describe the range; closer photographs reveal the motifs, shapes and materials. Glass reflections and display lighting retain the context of the store.

zh-CN.caption: Vivienne Westwood｜珠宝与腕表静物摄影

en.caption: Vivienne Westwood — Jewellery and Watch Still Life

zh-CN.text: 我把它单列为产品篇，是因为看产品和看店铺的重点确实不同。这里不需要把整间店重新讲一遍，注意力就放在这些小物件，以及它们在柜台里形成的组合上。

en.text: I have made this a separate product story because its focus differs from the interior series. The attention here stays with the small objects and the combinations they form inside the cases.

zh-CN.caption: Vivienne Westwood｜珠宝与腕表静物摄影

en.caption: Vivienne Westwood — Jewellery and Watch Still Life

zh-CN.title: 工作台上的钟表 DIY。
zh-CN.dek: 为美最时洋行旗下美时维工坊的钟表 DIY 培训提供全程视频拍摄与摄影，记录教学指导、工具使用与动手操作的细节。

en.title: DIY watchmaking at the workbench.
en.dek: Full-session video coverage and photography for a DIY watchmaking training project at Meishiwei Workshop, documenting hands-on practice, instruction and the use of precision tools.

zh-CN.text: 美最时洋行旗下美时维工坊开展钟表 DIY 培训，我为培训拍摄了全程视频和照片。这组影像从工作台展开：现场指导、参与者练习，以及工具和零件怎样被使用，都是记录的内容。

en.text: I photographed and filmed the full DIY watchmaking training at Treasure Care, part of Melchers. The coverage follows instruction, participant exercises and the use of tools and components at the workbench.

zh-CN.caption: 美时维工坊｜钟表 DIY 培训影像

en.caption: Meishiwei Workshop — DIY Watchmaking Training Coverage

zh-CN.text: 人物照片能看到专注的状态，操作特写则把手部动作交代得更清楚。安装工具、表盘和细小零件放在同一个画面里，读者才能把人正在做的事与工作台上的东西联系起来。

en.text: Portraits show the concentration of the participants; close-ups explain their hand movements. Tools, dials and small components share the frame so the activity can be understood in relation to the workbench.

zh-CN.caption: 美时维工坊｜钟表 DIY 培训影像

en.caption: Meishiwei Workshop — DIY Watchmaking Training Coverage

zh-CN.text: 这次记录里也有完成后的展示与合影。过程照片留在培训篇，成品则单独整理成静物篇。视频和照片分别承担连续记录与细节观看，不把两种交付混成一个模糊的“活动拍摄”。

en.text: The record also includes finished-piece presentations and group photographs. I have kept the process in this training story and the completed pieces in a separate still-life series. Video preserves continuity, while photographs allow the details to be examined.

zh-CN.caption: 美时维工坊｜钟表 DIY 培训影像

en.caption: Meishiwei Workshop — DIY Watchmaking Training Coverage

zh-CN.title: 做完之后，把每一只表看清楚。
zh-CN.dek: 为美时维工坊钟表 DIY 项目的成品拍摄静物照片，以系列陈列与局部特写呈现表盘色彩、图案纹理和金属表壳细节。

en.title: A closer look at the finished watches.
en.dek: Still-life photography of finished watches from Meishiwei Workshop's DIY project, combining collection views with close-ups of dial colours, patterns and metal case details.

zh-CN.text: 这组是钟表 DIY 项目完成后的成品摄影。和培训时的照片不同，画面里不再以教学过程为主角，而是让已经做出来的作品被单独看见。

en.text: This series photographs the completed pieces from the DIY watchmaking project. Unlike the training photographs, the finished objects themselves are the focus.

zh-CN.caption: 美时维工坊｜钟表 DIY 成品静物摄影

en.caption: Meishiwei Workshop — DIY Watch Product Photography

zh-CN.text: 灰色展示托盘把各只表分开，也衬出了表盘的颜色和图案。系列全景可以比较不同作品，单件特写则看指针、表壳和表盘纹理。这两种照片放在一起，比只挑一张好看的产品图更能说明这一组作品。

en.text: Grey display trays separate the watches and set off their dial colours and patterns. Collection views allow comparisons; individual close-ups show hands, cases and dial textures. The two distances describe the series more clearly together.

zh-CN.caption: 美时维工坊｜钟表 DIY 成品静物摄影

en.caption: Meishiwei Workshop — DIY Watch Product Photography

zh-CN.text: 我把这组从培训记录中拆出来，是想保留成品自己的观看节奏。读完前面的工作台故事，再看这些表，也能对应上从零件到完整外观的变化。

en.text: I have separated the finished pieces from the training coverage to give them their own viewing sequence. Seen after the workbench story, they also make the transition from components to completed watches visible.

zh-CN.title: Gerald Charles：从讲座看到展示桌。
zh-CN.dek: 与美时维工坊合作，在招商银行私人银行举办制表文化系列讲座，围绕 Gerald Charles 的品牌历史与制表知识展开分享，记录讲座现场、腕表展示和陈设细节。

en.title: Gerald Charles, from the lecture to the display table.
en.dek: A watchmaking culture lecture jointly organised with Meishiwei Workshop at China Merchants Bank Private Banking, exploring Gerald Charles brand history and watchmaking through lecture coverage, watch displays and event details.

zh-CN.text: 这次与美时维工坊合作，在招商银行私人银行举办制表文化系列讲座。内容围绕 Gerald Charles 的品牌历史与制表知识展开，我记录了讲者、听众、腕表展示和现场陈设。

en.text: This watchmaking-culture lecture was organised with Treasure Care at China Merchants Bank Private Banking. The programme covered Gerald Charles brand history and watchmaking knowledge; my photographs document the speakers, audience, watches and display setting.

zh-CN.caption: Gerald Charles｜招商银行私人银行制表文化讲座

en.caption: Gerald Charles — Watchmaking Culture Lecture at China Merchants Bank Private Banking

zh-CN.text: 在这组照片里，讲座和产品展示是连着的。讲者与听众的画面交代交流，展示桌、表盘和多色表带则把讲座涉及的对象具体呈现出来。只有会场全景，或者只有腕表特写，都不足以说明这次活动。

en.text: The lecture and the product displays belong to the same record. Speaker and audience photographs show the exchange, while tables, dials and coloured straps give the discussion a visible subject. Neither venue views nor watch close-ups alone describe the whole event.

zh-CN.caption: Gerald Charles｜招商银行私人银行制表文化讲座

en.caption: Gerald Charles — Watchmaking Culture Lecture at China Merchants Bank Private Banking

zh-CN.text: 专栏里我把这两条线交替放在一起。读者可以先看人在讲什么样的活动，再靠近看腕表；这里记录的是讲座与展示现场，不把它写成没有依据的产品评测。

en.text: I have interwoven those two strands here, moving from the lecture setting to closer views of the watches. This is a record of the event and its displays, rather than a product review.

zh-CN.caption: Gerald Charles｜招商银行私人银行制表文化讲座

en.caption: Gerald Charles — Watchmaking Culture Lecture at China Merchants Bank Private Banking

zh-CN.title: Brand SA，丽晶酒店里的相聚。
zh-CN.dek: 在上海浦东丽晶酒店记录与 Brand SA 合作的南非社群交流活动，涵盖现场布置、嘉宾发言、证书颁授、来宾交流与合影。

en.title: A Brand SA gathering at Regent Shanghai Pudong.
en.dek: Photography of a South African community gathering in collaboration with Brand SA at Regent Shanghai Pudong, covering the venue setup, speeches, certificate presentations, guest conversations and group portraits.

zh-CN.text: 这次在上海浦东丽晶酒店，记录与 Brand SA 合作的南非社群交流活动。Global South Africans Network 的现场展示、嘉宾发言、证书颁授和来宾合影，构成了这组照片的主要内容。

en.text: At Regent Shanghai Pudong, I documented a South African community gathering in collaboration with Brand SA. Global South Africans Network displays, speeches, certificate presentations and group portraits form the main record.

zh-CN.caption: Brand SA｜上海浦东丽晶酒店南非社群交流活动

en.caption: Brand SA — South African Community Gathering at Regent Shanghai Pudong

zh-CN.text: 正式环节之外，还有来宾之间的交流。人物特写和合影会给出不同的信息：一张看表情与手势，另一张看谁和谁站在一起。整理这组照片时，我把空间、流程和交流画面都留了下来。

en.text: Conversations among guests sit alongside the formal programme. Close portraits describe expressions and gestures; group photographs show people together. The selection keeps the venue, event sequence and exchanges in view.

zh-CN.caption: Brand SA｜上海浦东丽晶酒店南非社群交流活动

en.caption: Brand SA — South African Community Gathering at Regent Shanghai Pudong

zh-CN.text: 这场拍摄启用了索尼 FE 50–150mm F2 GM，整理的十张照片中有六张以这支镜头的 F2 光圈拍摄。照片里的前后景层次可以直接看，器材信息放在这里作为这次拍摄的记录，不替代对现场的描述。

en.text: This shoot introduced the Sony FE 50–150mm F2 GM into my setup. Six of the ten selected photographs were made with that lens at F2. Foreground and background separation can be seen in the images; the equipment detail is part of the shoot record, not a substitute for it.

zh-CN.title: 厦门爱歌合唱团：舞台与后台。
zh-CN.dek: 受邀记录厦门爱歌合唱团在东方艺术中心的演出，精选舞台全景、成员神态、现场发言、合唱团与观众的星光合照，以及后台成员肖像与合影。

en.title: Xiamen Aige Choir, on stage and backstage.
en.dek: An invited photographic record of Xiamen Aige Choir at Shanghai Oriental Art Center, featuring stage views, choir members, an on-stage address and a starlight group photograph with the audience, plus backstage portraits and paired photographs.

zh-CN.text: 受厦门爱歌合唱团邀请，我在东方艺术中心记录了这次演出。舞台全景里有合唱团、指挥和钢琴伴奏，靠近一些的画面则留下成员的神态与动作。两种距离一起看，演出才不只是一排站在台上的人。

en.text: Invited by Xiamen Aige Choir, I photographed the performance at Shanghai Oriental Art Center. Wider stage views show the choir, conductor and piano accompaniment; closer frames record expressions and gestures. The two distances describe the performance together.

zh-CN.caption: 厦门爱歌合唱团｜东方艺术中心演出

en.caption: Xiamen Aige Choir — Performance at Shanghai Oriental Art Center

zh-CN.text: 我把合唱团与观众共同参与的星光合照放在开头。它能直接交代舞台和观众的关系，再往后看演唱、发言和人物细节，就知道这些画面属于同一个现场。

en.text: I have opened with the starlight group photograph involving the choir and audience. It establishes their relationship before the singing, speaking and closer portraits are seen as parts of the same occasion.

zh-CN.caption: 厦门爱歌合唱团｜东方艺术中心演出

en.caption: Xiamen Aige Choir — Performance at Shanghai Oriental Art Center

zh-CN.text: 后台花絮也一起收进来了：走廊中的个人肖像、双人合影，和台上的正式画面有不同的状态。我希望这篇既能看到演出，也能看到演出之外的团员，而不是把后台另外当成几张随手的补充。

en.text: Backstage photographs are included too: individual portraits and paired photographs in the corridor offer a different view from the stage. They give the choir members a place in the story beyond the formal performance.

zh-CN.caption: 厦门爱歌合唱团｜东方艺术中心演出

en.caption: Xiamen Aige Choir — Performance at Shanghai Oriental Art Center

zh-CN.title: For Me / Eletre X 的国际媒体试驾记录。
zh-CN.dek: 为莲花 For Me / Eletre X 新车媒体试驾活动提供全程平面记录、海外媒体图片素材支持，以及贯穿拍摄流程的沟通与现场协调。

en.title: For Me / Eletre X: an international media-drive record.
en.dek: Full-event photography for the Lotus For Me / Eletre X media drive, with image delivery for international media and communication and on-site coordination throughout the shoot.

zh-CN.text: 这次莲花 For Me / Eletre X 国际媒体试驾，我负责全程平面记录，也配合海外媒体的图片需求与现场拍摄协调。车辆静态、动态试驾、车评人肖像和现场交流，都在这次拍摄的范围里。

en.text: For the Lotus For Me / Eletre X international media drive, I provided still photography throughout the event, supported overseas media image requirements and coordinated shooting on site. The coverage includes static cars, driving images, reviewer portraits and exchanges during the programme.

zh-CN.caption: 莲花 For Me / Eletre X｜国际媒体试驾影像

en.caption: Lotus For Me / Eletre X — International Media Drive Photography

zh-CN.text: 媒体试驾的照片要能分别回答几件具体的事：车是什么样，驾驶发生在怎样的环境里，媒体人物又处在什么状态。整理时我把这些内容放进同一套记录，而不是只留下几张整车照片。

en.text: The images need to show the vehicle, the setting of the drive and the people making the coverage. I have kept those subjects within one sequence rather than reducing the record to full-car photographs.

zh-CN.caption: 莲花 For Me / Eletre X｜国际媒体试驾影像

en.caption: Lotus For Me / Eletre X — International Media Drive Photography

zh-CN.text: 与英国汽车评论人士和海外媒体团队的协作，还包括拍摄安排、图片需求与素材交付。我把人物与车辆的画面一起整理，让不同的报道需求能在同一套素材里找到对应的图片。

en.text: Working with British automotive reviewers and international media teams also involved shooting arrangements, image requirements and delivery. Keeping people and vehicles in the same photographic record gives different editorial needs their corresponding images.

en.caption: Lotus For Me / Eletre X — International Media Drive Photography

zh-CN.title: Evija，黑金车身上的光。
zh-CN.dek: 为路特斯 Evija 在上海展出拍摄一组社交媒体照片，以整车构图与细节特写呈现黑金车身的线条、材质与光影。

en.title: Light across the black-and-gold Evija.
en.dek: A series of social media photographs created for the Lotus Evija's display in Shanghai, combining full-car compositions with close-ups of its black-and-gold finish, materials and reflections.

zh-CN.text: 这组为路特斯 Evija 在上海展出拍摄的社交媒体照片，以静态画面为主。整车构图先交代姿态，轮毂、后视镜和车身标识的特写，再把注意力带到具体的部位。

en.text: These social-media photographs document the Lotus Evija on display in Shanghai. Full-car compositions establish its stance, followed by closer views of the wheels, mirrors and body lettering.

zh-CN.caption: 路特斯 Evija｜上海展出社交媒体影像

en.caption: Lotus Evija — Shanghai Social Media Photography

zh-CN.text: 现场网格灯光映在黑色车身上，和金色饰线一起勾出曲面的变化。同一个反射，远看是整车的线条，近看又成为材质与表面的一部分。这也是整车与细节值得同时保留的原因。

en.text: The lighting grid reflects across the black bodywork and meets the gold accents. Seen from farther away, the reflections trace the car; closer views make them part of the surface and material. Both scales have a place in the series.

zh-CN.caption: 路特斯 Evija｜上海展出社交媒体影像

en.caption: Lotus Evija — Shanghai Social Media Photography

zh-CN.text: 这篇就专心看一辆展车。没有驾驶片段，也不加入没有拍到的性能叙事，留下现场的空间、车身和光线之间可以直接看到的关系。

en.text: This story stays with a single display car. It does not add a driving narrative or performance claims; it shows the visible relationship between the setting, bodywork and light.

zh-CN.caption: 路特斯 Evija｜上海展出社交媒体影像

en.caption: Lotus Evija — Shanghai Social Media Photography

zh-CN.title: 四明山，一段随车记录。
zh-CN.dek: 在宁波四明山，以随车动态摄影、驾驶者肖像与沿途停驻，记录 Lotus 跑车、Toyota GR Yaris 与 Porsche 911 Carrera GTS 敞篷共同展开的一段山路旅程。

en.title: Following a drive through Siming Mountain.
en.dek: An automotive photo story in Ningbo’s Siming Mountains, following Lotus sports cars, a Toyota GR Yaris and a Porsche 911 Carrera GTS Cabriolet through rolling shots, driver portraits and stops along the way.

zh-CN.text: 这组在宁波四明山完成，记录 Lotus 跑车、Toyota GR Yaris 和 Porsche 911 Carrera GTS 敞篷的山路行程，车手刘瑞琦也参与了这次出行。照片从集结进入山路，再回到座舱和途中停驻。

en.text: Photographed in Siming Mountain, Ningbo, this series follows Lotus sports cars, a Toyota GR Yaris and a Porsche 911 Carrera GTS Cabriolet. Racing driver Liu Ruiqi joined the outing. The photographs move from the gathering to the road, cockpit and stops along the way.

zh-CN.caption: 山路之间｜四明山驾驶纪实

en.caption: Between the Bends — A Siming Mountain Drive

zh-CN.text: 连续弯道和林间光影，是这段行程本身带来的背景。随车动态画面里，车身轮廓和流动的环境同时存在；驾驶者的肖像则把画面带回车里，让人和车都留在这套记录中。

en.text: Winding roads and light through the trees form the setting of the journey. Moving photographs keep the cars and landscape together, while driver portraits return the sequence to the cockpit.

zh-CN.caption: 山路之间｜四明山驾驶纪实

en.caption: Between the Bends — A Siming Mountain Drive

zh-CN.text: 我没有把停驻的片刻拿掉。把它们放在驾驶画面旁边，能让这组照片保留一次真实出行的顺序，而不只是几辆车在山路上的单张图片。

en.text: I have kept the quieter stops alongside the driving frames. They preserve the sequence of an outing rather than turning it into isolated pictures of cars on a mountain road.

zh-CN.caption: 山路之间｜四明山驾驶纪实

en.caption: Between the Bends — A Siming Mountain Drive

zh-CN.title: 天马赛道日，追焦之后再看一眼。
zh-CN.dek: 在上海天马国际赛车场，以动态追焦与维修区静态摄影，记录赛道日中车辆的行进姿态与驾驶之间的片刻。

en.title: Tianma track day: driving frames and the pit area.
en.dek: A track-day photo series at Shanghai Tianma International Circuit, combining on-track panning with still photographs in the pit area.

zh-CN.text: 上海天马国际赛车场这组赛道日照片，有直道、弯道，也有维修区。动态追焦留住车身轮廓与流动的背景，静态画面再补上车辆细节和现场环境。

en.text: This track-day series at Shanghai Tianma Circuit includes straights, corners and the pit area. Panning photographs place the cars against moving backgrounds; static frames add vehicle details and the setting around them.

zh-CN.caption: 弯道节奏｜天马赛车场赛道日

en.caption: Circuit Rhythm — A Track Day at Tianma

zh-CN.text: 同一辆车，行驶和停下来的观看重点不一样。动态照片里先看姿态，停驻时可以看车身局部。把两种画面排在一起，是为了让这一天的驾驶和间歇都出现在记录里。

en.text: The same car offers different things to see in motion and at rest. Driving frames describe its stance; parked views allow its details to be examined. Together they retain both driving and intervals from the day.

zh-CN.caption: 弯道节奏｜天马赛车场赛道日

en.caption: Circuit Rhythm — A Track Day at Tianma

zh-CN.text: 这次是赛道日纪实，没有必要把它写成比赛结果。我想留下的是车辆在这条赛道上的样子，以及驾驶活动周围那些也值得看的片刻。

en.text: This is a track-day record, not a report of race results. The photographs stay with the cars on this circuit and the moments surrounding the driving.

zh-CN.caption: 弯道节奏｜天马赛车场赛道日

en.caption: Circuit Rhythm — A Track Day at Tianma

zh-CN.title: 西太后的圣诞，从室外走到店里。
zh-CN.dek: 为 Vivienne Westwood 在中信泰富商场举办的圣诞活动提供摄影，记录节日装置、现场绘画互动与人物肖像，呈现品牌空间中的节日氛围。

en.title: Vivienne Westwood Christmas, outside and in the store.
en.dek: Photography for Vivienne Westwood's Christmas event at CITIC Square, capturing festive installations, live portrait illustration and guest portraits within the brand's retail setting.

zh-CN.text: 这次为 Vivienne Westwood 在中信泰富商场举办的圣诞活动拍摄。室外圣诞树上的品牌标识与装饰，是这组照片的起点；走进店里，内容变成绘画互动、饮品制作和来宾肖像。

en.text: I photographed the Vivienne Westwood Christmas event at CITIC Square. The outdoor tree, its branding and ornaments open the series; inside the store, the coverage turns to live portrait illustration, drink preparation and guest portraits.

zh-CN.caption: Vivienne Westwood｜中信泰富圣诞活动

en.caption: Vivienne Westwood — Christmas Event at CITIC Square

zh-CN.text: 绘画过程和拿着画作的肖像，能把互动前后连起来。调饮的动作、展示柜与人物也在同一个空间里，它们交代的是这场活动的具体内容，不只是一个圣诞装饰背景。

en.text: The illustration session and portraits with the finished drawings connect different stages of the interaction. Drink preparation, display cases and guests show what took place in the store, beyond the festive decoration.

zh-CN.caption: Vivienne Westwood｜中信泰富圣诞活动

en.caption: Vivienne Westwood — Christmas Event at CITIC Square

zh-CN.text: 我把室外与室内都留下，让人能从商场的节日装置一路看到店内体验。这次的摄影记录包含空间，也包含实际发生在空间里的人和事。

en.text: I have kept the outdoor and indoor photographs together, moving from the mall installation to the experience inside the store. People and activity are part of the record alongside the space.

zh-CN.caption: Vivienne Westwood｜中信泰富圣诞活动

en.caption: Vivienne Westwood — Christmas Event at CITIC Square

en.dek: Photography of the MLILY × Manchester United Zero-Pressure Carnival with Andy Cole at Red Star Macalline's Shanghai Wenshui mall, capturing fan interactions, shirt signing, group portraits and the branded setting.

en.text: At the Shanghai stop of the 2025 MLILY × Manchester United carnival, held at Red Star Macalline Wenshui Mall, I photographed Andy Cole with fans, shirt signing, stage portraits and the event space in the atrium.

zh-CN.caption: 2025 梦百合 × 曼联 0压嘉年华｜上海站

en.caption: 2025 MLILY × Manchester United Zero-Pressure Carnival — Shanghai

zh-CN.text: 全景里能看到红蓝色的布置和人群，靠近之后则是球衣、动作和笑容。两种距离串起来，品牌现场和球迷相聚就不会被拆成互不相关的两套照片。

en.text: Wider frames show the red-and-blue setting and the crowd. Closer views turn to shirts, gestures and smiles. Together they connect the brand event with the fan gathering.

zh-CN.caption: 2025 梦百合 × 曼联 0压嘉年华｜上海站

en.caption: 2025 MLILY × Manchester United Zero-Pressure Carnival — Shanghai

zh-CN.text: 这一篇保留互动环节的照片，而不只挑嘉宾面对镜头的那几张。签名和合影本身就是当天的重要内容，球迷也应该在这套记录里有自己的位置。

en.text: I have kept the interactions rather than only the guest portraits. Signing and group photographs were important parts of the day, and the fans belong in the record too.

en.dek: Red carpet portraits and interview-area photography at the third Forbes China Beauty Industry Top 100 Brands Awards at Shangri-La Qiantan in Shanghai.

zh-CN.text: 这一组来自上海前滩香格里拉，记录第三届福布斯中国美业品牌100评选颁奖盛典的红毯人物与采访现场。拍摄范围是这两个区域，不把照片没有覆盖的整场流程算进来。

en.text: This series was made at Shangri-La Qiantan, Shanghai, during the third Forbes China Beauty Industry Brand 100 awards ceremony. My coverage here centres on red-carpet portraits and the interview area, rather than the entire programme.

zh-CN.caption: 第三届福布斯中国美业品牌100评选颁奖盛典｜红毯人物影像

en.caption: Third Forbes China Beauty Industry Top 100 Brands Awards — Red Carpet Portraits

zh-CN.text: 红色背景和线性灯光，为人物肖像提供了清楚的现场线索。近景里看神态与礼服细节，采访画面则把麦克风、标识和动作一起留下，让人物回到盛典的语境中。

en.text: Red backdrops and linear lighting establish the setting of the portraits. Closer frames show expressions and gown details; interview photographs retain microphones, signage and gestures around the subject.

zh-CN.caption: 第三届福布斯中国美业品牌100评选颁奖盛典｜红毯人物影像

en.caption: Third Forbes China Beauty Industry Top 100 Brands Awards — Red Carpet Portraits

zh-CN.text: 我把这两类画面放在同一篇里。读者先认识照片中的人物状态，再看到采访区域的关系；红毯摄影也因此不只是换了一个背景的人像。

en.text: I have paired these two views so portraits are read alongside the interview setting. The event context remains visible rather than becoming only a backdrop.

zh-CN.title: 西音录音棚里的大提琴演奏会。
zh-CN.dek: 在上海西音音乐录音棚，以演奏者肖像、钢琴伴奏与观众视角，记录一场大提琴演奏会的现场。

en.title: A cello recital at Xiyin recording studio.
en.dek: A photographic record of a cello recital at Xiyin Music Recording Studio in Shanghai, bringing together performer portraits, piano accompaniment and views from the audience.

zh-CN.text: 这场大提琴演奏会在上海西音音乐录音棚举行。木质空间、琴身和温暖的现场灯光都留在画面里，人物近景则记录演奏者的专注与弓弦动作。

en.text: This cello recital took place at Xiyin recording studio in Shanghai. The wooden interior, instruments and warm lighting remain in the frames, with closer photographs recording concentration and bow movement.

zh-CN.caption: 弦间光影｜西音录音棚大提琴演奏会

en.caption: Light Between the Strings — A Cello Recital at Xiyin

zh-CN.text: 演奏者的单人画面之外，我也把钢琴和大提琴同台的照片留了下来。不同乐器在同一个空间里，观众视角又补上了观看的距离。这样整理，比只看演奏者的特写更能理解现场。

en.text: Alongside individual portraits, the series includes cello and piano sharing the space. Perspectives from the audience add the distance of listening, giving the recital more context than close-ups alone.

zh-CN.caption: 弦间光影｜西音录音棚大提琴演奏会

en.caption: Light Between the Strings — A Cello Recital at Xiyin

zh-CN.text: 这套演出影像没有用很大的叙事去包裹它。一个录音棚、一场演奏、人物与乐器之间的动作，就已经是这一篇值得仔细看的内容。

en.text: This story stays close to what was photographed: a recital in a recording studio, and the gestures connecting performers with their instruments.

zh-CN.title: OMEN，统一背景里不同的人。
zh-CN.dek: 为项目成员拍摄统一视觉语言的人物定妆照，保留自然姿态与清晰的品牌环境信息。

en.title: Individual people in a consistent OMEN portrait setting.
en.dek: A consistent portrait series for project participants, combining relaxed individual poses with a clear branded environment.

zh-CN.text: 这组是惠普 OMEN 项目成员的定妆照。背景、光线和构图保持统一，让它们放在一起时是一套完整的人物照片；每个人的姿态和个体特征，又需要在这套统一画面里被看见。

en.text: These are cast portraits for an HP OMEN project. A consistent background, lighting setup and composition make them a coherent set while retaining each person’s posture and individual features.

zh-CN.caption: 惠普 OMEN 人物定妆照

en.caption: HP OMEN Cast Portraits

zh-CN.text: 品牌环境提供了清楚的背景信息，但人物仍是照片的重点。我把不同成员的肖像并列展示，方便看见这组拍摄的统一性，也方便比较其中自然的变化。

en.text: The brand setting supplies context, while the people remain the focus. I have presented the portraits alongside one another so both their consistency and differences are visible.

zh-CN.caption: 惠普 OMEN 人物定妆照

en.caption: HP OMEN Cast Portraits

zh-CN.text: 定妆照并不需要每个人做完全一样的表情。对这篇来说，同一套视觉条件下出现的不同状态，比再添加一段笼统的品牌介绍更有用。

en.text: A consistent portrait series does not require identical expressions. The different states visible within the same visual conditions are the subject of this story.

zh-CN.caption: 惠普 OMEN 人物定妆照

en.caption: HP OMEN Cast Portraits

zh-CN.title: 中船动力：把一天的流程留完整。
zh-CN.dek: 完整记录企业揭牌、培训分享、技术参观、嘉宾交流与集体合影等关键环节。

en.title: CSSC Power: keeping the event sequence intact.
en.dek: Comprehensive coverage of an unveiling ceremony, training sessions, technical visits, guest exchanges and formal group portraits.

zh-CN.text: 中船动力这组企业活动，有揭牌、培训分享、技术参观、嘉宾交流和集体合影。我沿着这些环节完成拍摄，让一组照片能够清楚交代当天做了哪些事。

en.text: The CSSC Power event included an unveiling, training, technical visits, guest conversations and group photographs. My coverage follows those stages to make the programme readable as a photographic record.

zh-CN.caption: 中船动力企业活动纪实

en.caption: CSSC Power Corporate Event Documentary

zh-CN.text: 正式环节需要交代人物与现场，交流画面则能看到参与者之间的关系。空间细节也值得保留：它们说明事情发生在哪里，不能让所有照片只剩下单独的人像。

en.text: Formal stages establish people and setting; conversation photographs show participants in relation to one another. Environmental details also explain where the activities took place.

zh-CN.caption: 中船动力企业活动纪实

en.caption: CSSC Power Corporate Event Documentary

zh-CN.text: 我把这篇按流程整理，而不是把最好看的几张随机摆在一起。翻完之后，读者应该可以分清揭牌、分享和参观各自的画面，这也是企业活动记录很实际的一部分。

en.text: I have organised the story by its sequence rather than placing individual favourites in a random order. The unveiling, presentations and visits remain identifiable as distinct parts of the event.

zh-CN.caption: 中船动力企业活动纪实

en.caption: CSSC Power Corporate Event Documentary

zh-CN.title: 一尺花园，练习中的表情和动作。
zh-CN.dek: 记录戏剧疗愈活动中的引导、互动、练习与合影，呈现参与者之间自然、开放的交流状态。

en.title: Expressions and movement at Yichi Huayuan.
en.dek: A documentary of facilitation, exercises, interaction and group portraits, capturing an open and natural exchange between participants.

zh-CN.text: 这一组记录一尺花园的戏剧疗愈活动。照片跟随引导、练习、互动和分享展开，人物的表情、肢体动作以及大家站在一起的关系，是比单张合影更多的内容。

en.text: This series documents a drama-therapy workshop at Yichi Huayuan. It follows facilitation, exercises, interaction and sharing, with attention to expressions, movement and how participants appear together.

zh-CN.caption: 一尺花园戏剧疗愈活动

en.caption: Yichi Garden Drama Therapy Workshop

zh-CN.text: 我把练习过程放在专栏的中心。近一点看个人反应，远一点看群体怎样互动，两种画面可以帮助读者理解活动形式，而不是只知道“这里办过一次活动”。

en.text: I have put the exercises at the centre of the story. Closer frames show individual responses; wider photographs describe group interaction and make the form of the workshop visible.

zh-CN.caption: 一尺花园戏剧疗愈活动

en.caption: Yichi Garden Drama Therapy Workshop

zh-CN.text: 这里不根据一张表情判断参与者的心理，也不替活动写疗效结论。影像保留的是当时看得见的交流和动作，合影则作为这次相聚的另一种记录。

en.text: The photographs do not diagnose anyone’s feelings or make claims about therapeutic outcomes. They record visible exchanges and gestures, with group portraits as another part of the gathering.

zh-CN.caption: 一尺花园戏剧疗愈活动

en.caption: Yichi Garden Drama Therapy Workshop

zh-CN.title: Te Amo，三十岁的红色派对。
zh-CN.dek: 以强烈的红色空间为视觉基调，记录三十岁生日聚会的个人肖像、朋友互动、空间布置与集体合影。

en.title: A red birthday party at Te Amo.
en.dek: Set within a vivid red interior, this series documents personal portraits, friendships, styling details and group moments at a 30th birthday celebration.

zh-CN.text: 上海 Te Amo 的这场三十岁生日聚会，有一个非常鲜明的红色空间。个人肖像、朋友互动、现场布置和集体合影，都围绕这个空间展开，它也是这一组照片最直接的视觉线索。

en.text: The thirtieth-birthday gathering at Te Amo in Shanghai took place in a vivid red interior. Portraits, friends, decorations and group photographs share that setting, which gives the series its clearest visual thread.

zh-CN.caption: 上海 Te Amo 三十岁生日聚会

en.caption: 30th Birthday Celebration at Te Amo, Shanghai

zh-CN.text: 我把派对中热闹的画面和相对安静的肖像一起留下。空间颜色很强，人物之间的交流也需要被看见；照片里既有聚会的样子，也有属于生日主角的单独时刻。

en.text: I have kept energetic party frames alongside quieter portraits. The strong colour belongs to the setting, while exchanges among friends and individual portraits give people their own place within it.

zh-CN.caption: 上海 Te Amo 三十岁生日聚会

en.caption: 30th Birthday Celebration at Te Amo, Shanghai

zh-CN.text: 私人活动的故事不需要替主角补写人生感悟。三十岁这一天的朋友、布置和人物状态，就可以构成一份具体的纪念。

en.text: A personal celebration does not need an invented life reflection. The friends, decorations and portraits from that day make a specific record of the birthday.

zh-CN.title: 上海露台上的求婚。
zh-CN.dek: 在温暖、私密的聚会氛围中记录求婚现场、亲友互动与情绪瞬间。

en.title: A proposal on a Shanghai terrace.
en.dek: An intimate, warmly lit documentary of a proposal celebration, preserving the reactions and interactions shared with family and friends.

zh-CN.text: 这组私人求婚纪实在上海宝格丽的露台拍摄。求婚前后的准备、反应、拥抱和亲友互动，是照片里的主要内容。它属于人物与私人纪实这一组，记录的是主角与亲友的相聚。

en.text: This private proposal was photographed on the terrace at Bulgari in Shanghai. The series covers preparation, reactions, embraces and exchanges with family and friends, as part of my personal documentary work.

zh-CN.caption: 宝格丽上海露台求婚纪实

en.caption: Proposal at Bvlgari Shanghai Terrace

zh-CN.text: 露台与自然光交代了环境，人物画面则把注意力带到事件本身。我把关键瞬间和前后的照片放在一起，让求婚不是只有一个单独被截下来的动作。

en.text: The terrace and natural light establish the environment, while the people carry the occasion. I have kept the decisive moment alongside photographs from before and after it.

zh-CN.caption: 宝格丽上海露台求婚纪实

en.caption: Proposal at Bvlgari Shanghai Terrace

zh-CN.text: 这些照片里的亲友也值得留下。看他们的反应，再看两位主角，能让这篇保留一场私人相聚的完整关系，而不只是两个人面对镜头的合影。

en.text: Family and friends belong in the record too. Their responses place the couple within the gathering rather than limiting the story to posed portraits of two people.

zh-CN.title: 十岁生日，蛋糕之外还有这些画面。
zh-CN.dek: 记录一场儿童十岁生日宴中的人物肖像、亲友互动、蛋糕与气球布置，以及窗边夜景下的庆祝片段。

en.title: A tenth birthday, beyond the cake.
en.dek: Portraits, interactions among guests, cake and balloon decorations, and moments of celebration beside a night-time city view at a child’s tenth birthday party.

zh-CN.text: 这一组儿童十岁生日宴照片，围绕生日主角和现场亲友展开。正式肖像、蛋糕前的庆祝和窗边的自然片段放在一起，让主角在不同环节里的样子都能被留下。

en.text: This tenth-birthday series follows the birthday child and family and friends. Formal portraits, the celebration beside the cake and candid moments by the window preserve different parts of the occasion.

zh-CN.caption: 儿童十岁生日宴

en.caption: A Child’s Tenth Birthday Celebration

zh-CN.text: 气球、花艺和成长照片展板，补上了这场生日宴的具体细节。它们和人物照片并列时，能看出这是一场怎样被布置的生日，而不是任何一次都可以套用的庆祝背景。

en.text: Balloons, flowers and a display of childhood photographs add specific details. Alongside the portraits, they describe the setting of this particular celebration.

zh-CN.caption: 儿童十岁生日宴

en.caption: A Child’s Tenth Birthday Celebration

zh-CN.text: 我把窗边的片段也留进了这篇。看蛋糕、看合影，再看到这些较自然的画面，这一天的记录会多一些停顿，人物也不必每一张都在正式看镜头。

en.text: I have kept the window-side moments too. They provide pauses beside the cake and group portraits, allowing the people to appear without always facing the camera formally.

zh-CN.dek: 在上海中环，以新人肖像、婚车旁的亲密互动与亲友交流，记录婚礼中的温柔瞬间。

en.title: Beside the wedding car.
en.dek: Couple portraits, intimate moments beside the wedding car and exchanges with loved ones from a wedding in Shanghai's Zhonghuan area.

zh-CN.text: 上海中环这组婚礼纪实，从车窗里的新娘肖像，看到新人相吻、举起捧花和亲友交流。婚车不只是背景，车窗和车身倒影也参与了画面的构图。

en.text: This wedding series in Zhonghuan, Shanghai, moves from a bridal portrait in the car window to a kiss, a raised bouquet and exchanges with loved ones. Windows and reflections make the car part of the framing as well as the setting.

zh-CN.caption: 相伴此刻｜上海中环婚礼纪实

en.caption: Together in the Moment — A Wedding in Shanghai's Zhonghuan Area

zh-CN.text: 白色婚纱、粉色花束和自然光，让这些照片有了柔和的层次。比起单独强调礼服或花束，我更愿意把它们和人物的动作一起看：照片的内容仍然是新人之间，以及新人和亲友之间的关系。

en.text: A white gown, pink flowers and natural light give the frames a gentle palette. I have kept these details in relation to gestures between the couple and with family and friends.

zh-CN.caption: 相伴此刻｜上海中环婚礼纪实

en.caption: Together in the Moment — A Wedding in Shanghai's Zhonghuan Area

zh-CN.text: 这一篇保留的是婚礼中的一段，不把没有覆盖到的仪式流程补写进来。车旁的亲密互动和俯身交流，已经能具体说明这一组影像记录了什么。

en.text: This article describes a portion of the wedding rather than adding an unrecorded ceremony. The close interactions beside the car are the specific subject of the series.

zh-CN.title: 把一件事做完整，比把公司说得很大更重要。
zh-CN.dek: 从一组花艺照片到一场企业活动，我更在意客户最后拿到什么，以及这些画面能不能真正用起来。
zh-CN.pull_quote: 我希望客户记住的，是这次合作把事情做清楚了。

en.title: Finish the work. Let the studio grow from there.
en.dek: From floral portraits to a corporate event, I care about what the client receives and how the images will be used.
en.pull_quote: I want clients to remember that the work was clear and properly finished.

zh-CN.text: 我经常会想，一个工作室到底应该让人看到什么。名字可以起得很好，网站也可以做得很漂亮。但客户找过来，通常有一件很具体的事：活动要记录，人物要拍，空间要展示，或者一支片子需要有人从头做到尾。我们最后还是要回到这些事情上。

en.text: I often think about what a studio should let people see. A good name and a good website help. But a client usually arrives with something specific: an event to record, a person to photograph, a space to show or a film to take from the first conversation to the finished edit. Those tasks are where we earn our place.

zh-CN.caption: 花小念花艺形象拍摄

en.caption: Huaxiaonian Floral Brand Portraits

zh-CN.text: 拿花小念那组花艺形象照片来说，画面里有花，也有人。只把花拍得漂亮还不够，人物在旁边是什么状态、室内颜色会不会抢掉花材的层次，都要放在一起看。这些关系处理好了，照片才像这个品牌自己的东西。

en.text: The Huaxiaonian floral portraits bring flowers and people into the same frame. A beautiful arrangement alone does not settle the picture. The person beside it, the room colours and the layers of the flowers all have to work together. That is how an image starts to belong to a particular brand.

zh-CN.text: 换到中船动力的企业活动，重点又变了。揭牌、培训、参观、交流、合影，每个环节都带着信息。某一张抓拍很好看，不能代替整场活动被清楚地交代。客户拿到这组素材，应该能找到需要的画面，也能看明白当天发生了什么。

en.text: The CSSC Power event asks for something different. An unveiling, training, visits, conversations and group photographs each carry information. One strong candid image cannot explain the whole day. The client needs a set they can navigate and use.

zh-CN.text: 所以我对“小团队”的理解很实际：沟通的链条短一点，做决定的人离现场近一点。需要增加摄像、助理或后期的时候，就根据任务把合适的人加进来。最后谁负责沟通、谁负责拍摄、谁整理文件，要清楚。

en.text: A small team makes practical sense to me when communication is short and decisions stay close to the shoot. We bring in camera operators, assistants and editors as the assignment requires. Who speaks to the client, who shoots and who handles the files should be clear.

zh-CN.text: 我也在意交付之后的那一步。同一张照片，用在网站、公众号和内部汇报里，阅读环境完全不同。前面就把用途说清楚，后面选片、排顺序和输出尺寸，才有依据。

en.text: The destination of the work matters too. A photograph on a website, in a WeChat article and in an internal presentation meets three different reading conditions. Knowing the use early gives us a basis for selection, sequence and delivery.

zh-CN.text: 如果你第一次找我们，我希望先知道的其实很简单：这次拍摄要给谁看，哪一天需要用，哪些画面不能漏。参考图也可以发，但我更想知道你喜欢它的什么。是光线，是颜色，还是它把一件复杂的事讲得很清楚？把这个说出来，比双方对着一句“要高级”各自理解要好。

en.text: When someone first gets in touch, I want to know who will see the work, when it is needed and which pictures cannot be missed. References help, especially when we can say what is useful about them: the light, the colour or the clarity. That gives us something more precise to work with than the word “premium”.

zh-CN.text: 网站也是这件事的一部分。我不希望照片只在摄影师的大屏幕上好看，到了客户的手机上却找不到重点。横图和竖图怎么一起看，标题会不会压住人物，影片是不是点开才加载，这些看似是网站的问题，其实都关系到作品最后有没有被好好看见。

en.text: The website is part of the same responsibility. A picture should work beyond the photographer’s large monitor. The relationship between landscape and portrait frames, the position of a title and the decision to load a film only when requested all affect how the work is seen.

zh-CN.text: RFG 还在一点点往前做。我没有特别想把它介绍成一个无所不能的公司。对我来说，把眼前这件事做好，把合作的人照顾好，再留下下一次合作的理由，这样的增长比较实在。

en.text: RFG is still growing. I want that growth to come from completed work and people who want to work with us again. Doing the assignment properly is a more useful introduction than a grand description of the company.

zh-CN.title: 有人在认真做一件事的时候，画面就有了。
zh-CN.dek: 从梗犬美容示范到戏剧活动，聊聊我为什么会把镜头留给手、表情和人之间的关系。
zh-CN.pull_quote: 有些照片里的主角，是一个动作。

en.title: When someone is absorbed in the work, there is a picture.
en.dek: A terrier grooming demonstration and a theatre workshop offer different ways to look at hands, expressions and relationships.
en.pull_quote: Sometimes the main subject of a photograph is an action.

zh-CN.text: 梗犬美容沙龙这组照片，吸引我的地方很具体：有人在做示范，周围的人在看，狗也在画面里。它没有一个始终端正面对镜头的主角，注意力跟着操作走。光看这些照片，就能读到一种很直接的现场关系。

en.text: The terrier grooming photographs have a very specific arrangement: someone demonstrates, people watch and the dog remains part of the scene. There is no single subject facing the camera throughout. Attention follows the work.

zh-CN.caption: 梗犬宠物美容沙龙

en.caption: Terrier Grooming Salon

zh-CN.text: 工具、手的位置、宠物的状态、观众的表情，各有各的作用。远一点拍，可以交代大家怎么围在一起；近一点拍，才能看清操作。再留一些反应，整组画面就有了来回，而不只是重复同一个角度。

en.text: Tools, hand positions, the animal and the audience each have a role. A wider frame explains how people gather. A closer one makes the operation readable. Reactions let the sequence move between the demonstration and its audience.

zh-CN.text: 一尺花园的戏剧疗愈活动，是另一个节奏。作品里有练习、互动、分享，也有参与者之间的表情和肢体变化。这样的内容让我更在意人与人之间发生了什么，拍摄也需要给他们留空间。

en.text: The theatre workshop at Yichihuayuan has another rhythm. The photographs include exercises, interaction and sharing, with changes in gesture and expression. Here I am more interested in what passes between people and in leaving them room.

zh-CN.text: 我觉得纪实照片最怕的，是把现场拍成了一份没有重点的签到记录。人都拍到了，环节也拍到了，但看完还是不知道这次活动有什么特别。对我来说，那个特别的地方常常在一个动作里，或者在两个人之间。

en.text: An event record can include every person and every item on the programme yet still say little about the occasion. I look for what makes this gathering particular. Often it is a movement or a relationship between two people.

zh-CN.text: 整理照片时，我会用这几个问题来看一组内容：场所交代清楚了吗？动作看得懂吗？照片里的反应有没有和前一张接上？一张很好看的照片，放进整组里未必就有用；一张看起来很普通的细节，有时能把前后连起来。

en.text: I read a sequence with a few questions in mind. Is the place clear? Can the action be understood? Does this reaction connect with the preceding image? A striking photograph may not help the sequence, while a modest detail can link two parts.

zh-CN.text: 看沙龙的照片，观众举起来的手机也很有意思。它告诉你，大家此刻觉得什么值得记下来。画面中不只有摄影师在选择角度，现场的人也在看、也在记录。我喜欢保留这种层次，它会让一场示范看起来更像正在发生的事情。

en.text: The raised phones in the salon photographs are interesting too. They show what the audience considers worth keeping. The photographer is not the only person choosing a view; people in the room are watching and recording as well. That gives the demonstration another layer.

zh-CN.text: 但认真观察不等于什么都公开。尤其涉及家庭、孩子或比较私人的活动，照片拍到了和照片适合放在作品集里，是两次不同的选择。网站上应该留下能够说明工作、也在确认的公开范围内的内容。镜头可以靠近，发布时还是要有分寸。

en.text: Observation and publication are separate choices, particularly around families, children and private gatherings. A portfolio should show the work within its agreed public scope. Being close enough to photograph something does not by itself make it right to publish.

zh-CN.text: 这些项目也让我觉得，题材的大小并不能决定画面有没有意思。有人认真做一件事，旁边有人认真看，这已经值得拍。把这种关系留下来，很多时候比让所有人都看向镜头更有内容。

en.text: A subject does not need to be grand to hold my attention. Someone taking a task seriously, with someone else watching closely, is already worth photographing. There is a lot to keep in that relationship.

zh-CN.title: S5II，以及一台相机之外的事。
zh-CN.dek: 滴水湖人像、书院民宿空间照片里都有松下 S5II。借这些实际作品，聊聊机身、镜头、光线和交付之间的关系。
zh-CN.pull_quote: 我更关心这套设备到了现场，能不能把需要的画面留下来。

en.title: The S5II, and what sits around a camera.
en.dek: The Dishui Lake portraits and Shuyuan interiors include work made with the Panasonic S5II. They offer a practical starting point for talking about equipment.
en.pull_quote: I care about whether the setup can bring back the pictures the assignment needs.

zh-CN.text: 如果要介绍器材，我想先从已经拍出来的东西说起。滴水湖清晨跑步人像、书院民宿的室内照片，还有上海露台求婚的这组照片，都用到了松下 LUMIX S5II。三个现场的内容差别很大，也正好能说明：一台机身并不会决定照片只有一种样子。

en.text: I would rather introduce equipment through finished photographs. The morning running portraits at Dishui Lake, the Shuyuan interiors and the Shanghai rooftop proposal photographs include work made with the Panasonic LUMIX S5II. These are three very different subjects. One camera does not give every assignment the same look.

zh-CN.caption: 书院民宿空间摄影

en.caption: Shuyuan Guesthouse Interior Photography

zh-CN.text: S5II 是一台全画幅无反相机，同时提供照片和视频拍摄能力，并采用相位混合自动对焦。关于它的规格，松下有很完整的介绍。我更想聊的是，面对跑动的人、窗边的室内空间和人群里的表情，拍摄者分别要做什么判断。

en.text: The S5II is a full-frame mirrorless camera with stills and video capabilities and phase hybrid autofocus. Panasonic provides a detailed specification. What interests me here is how the photographer responds to a moving person, a room beside a window or an expression in a gathering.

zh-CN.text: 滴水湖这组照片里，人物在动。构图要跟上动作，又要给身体和运动方向留下空间。相机对焦是一部分，拍摄位置和按快门的时机也是一部分。背景里有湖岸、城市和一段很长的影子，不能只盯着人物，把这些关系全丢掉。

en.text: At Dishui Lake, the subject is moving. The frame needs room for the body and the direction of travel. Focus is one part of that; position and timing are others. The shoreline, distant city and long shadow also belong to the photograph.

zh-CN.text: 到了书院民宿，注意力就落到窗户、墙面、家具和颜色上。焦段会改变前后关系，机位会改变线条，明暗又决定了空间怎么被读到。广一点可以交代房间，但不能只追求“看起来很大”；我更在意人能不能从照片里理解这个地方。

en.text: In the Shuyuan interiors, attention shifts to windows, walls, furniture and colour. Focal length changes spatial relationships, position changes lines and light changes how a room reads. A wide view can describe a room, but making it look bigger is not the whole task.

zh-CN.text: 同样的道理也适用于灯光、稳定设备和收音。它们需要围绕任务来选：要保留自然光的样子，还是需要更可控的人像光线？镜头是在移动，还是可以安静地停下来？片子里有没有必须听清的讲话？这些问题比先列一长串品牌更有用。

en.text: Lighting, stabilisation and sound should be considered in the same way. Does the picture need the character of available light or a controlled portrait setup? Is the camera moving? Is there speech that must be heard clearly? Those questions give equipment a purpose.

zh-CN.text: 镜头怎么选，我更愿意从站在哪里说起。窗边的房间需要把家具之间的距离交代清楚，跑步的人需要前进的空间，活动里的发言者又不能一直被摄影师挡住。焦段是在帮你安排这些关系。把所有东西都拍成很浅的景深，看着可能轻松，信息却不一定够。

en.text: For lenses, I would start with where the camera can stand. A room needs readable distances between furniture. A runner needs space in the direction of movement. A speaker should not have the photographer blocking the audience. Focal length helps arrange those relationships; shallow depth of field is not always the answer.

zh-CN.text: 如果拍的是浦东美术馆这样的导览影片，声音也得进入器材的讨论。讲述是线索，画面再漂亮，观众听不清就跟不上。现场收音、字幕和剪辑顺序需要一起考虑。介绍一套拍摄方法的时候，我想把这部分也讲出来，而不只给你看一台相机的外观。

en.text: For a guided exhibition film such as the Museum of Art Pudong project, sound belongs in the equipment discussion. The explanation carries the sequence. Location sound, subtitles and the edit need to work together so the viewer can follow it. A camera body is only one part of that method.

zh-CN.text: 电池、存储卡、备份和文件命名，介绍起来没有那么精彩，但我希望器材这一栏也把这些事情放进去。客户真正接触到的，是完整的照片和影片。器材的价值，最后应该在这些内容里看得见。

en.text: Power, storage, backup and file names are less exciting to discuss, but they belong in the equipment conversation. The client meets the finished photographs and films. That is where the value of the setup has to become visible.

zh-CN.title: 我是 Richard，这就是我正在做的 RFG。
zh-CN.dek: 摄影、影片、汽车、活动，还有一家在上海逐渐成形的工作室。把现在做的事讲具体一点。
zh-CN.pull_quote: 我想让别人看过作品以后，知道我们能一起做什么。

en.title: I am Richard. This is the RFG I am building.
en.dek: Photography, films, cars, events and a studio taking shape in Shanghai. A more specific introduction to what we do.
en.pull_quote: I want the work to make it clear what we could make together.

zh-CN.text: 我是 Richard，在上海做摄影和影像制作。RFG 的全称是 Rich First Generation。这个名字听起来有一点野心，我也确实希望亲手把工作室做起来。不过，解释我们是谁，还是得从已经做过的项目开始。

en.text: I am Richard, a photographer and image maker based in Shanghai. RFG stands for Rich First Generation. The name carries some ambition, and I do want to build the studio myself. The clearest introduction, though, comes from the work already made.

zh-CN.caption: 中船动力企业活动纪实

en.caption: CSSC Power Corporate Event Documentary

zh-CN.text: 我们的作品里有平潭的莲花车队，有浦东美术馆的展览导览，也有学术会议、企业活动、花艺形象和民宿空间。看起来很不一样，但都要解决同一件很实际的事：把一个人、一个场所或一件正在发生的事，变成别人看得懂、愿意看的内容。

en.text: That work includes the Lotus team in Pingtan, an exhibition tour at the Museum of Art Pudong, academic and corporate events, floral portraits and guesthouse interiors. Each needs a person, a place or an occasion to become something other people can understand and want to look at.

zh-CN.text: 我喜欢汽车，也在意设计和画面本身。汽车项目里，车辆的线条、车手和团队的状态都值得看；人物和活动里，我又会更注意表情、动作和人与人的关系。这些兴趣放在一起，慢慢形成了 RFG 现在的样子。

en.text: Cars interest me, as do design and the picture itself. In automotive work I look at the vehicle, the driver and the team. With portraits and events, expressions, actions and relationships move forward. Together, these interests shape the studio.

zh-CN.text: 我们做摄影，也做影片和后期。前期要把需求说清楚，现场要知道重点在哪，回来以后还要把照片或片子整理成能使用的东西。对我来说，这些环节连在一起，才算是在做一个项目。

en.text: We make photographs and films and work on their finishing. The brief needs to be clear, the shoot needs a focus and the material needs to become usable photographs or a coherent edit. I see those stages as connected parts of one assignment.

zh-CN.text: RFG Studio 是工作室对外使用的名字，运营主体是奕曜序（上海）传媒科技有限公司。公司承担项目合作和业务运营，工作室这个名字则承载作品和创作方向。我们既和客户直接沟通，也和制作团队及创意伙伴一起工作。

en.text: RFG Studio is our public studio name. The business is operated by 奕曜序（上海）传媒科技有限公司. The company handles project cooperation and operations, while the studio name carries the work and its creative direction. We work directly with clients and alongside production and creative partners.

zh-CN.text: 做这个网站的时候，我最不想看到的是：介绍里每个词都很漂亮，点进作品却不知道我们具体做了什么。所以我想把项目拆开讲。平潭那组为什么同时放赛车和维修区，美术馆影片为什么要留参观者，空间照片为什么不能只挑最广的角度。这些选择，比一句“提供一站式服务”更能说明我。

en.text: While building this website, I want the introduction to stay connected to the work. Why show both the car and the pit lane in Pingtan? Why keep visitors in an exhibition film? Why resist selecting only the widest room views? Those decisions say more about me than a broad service claim.

zh-CN.text: 至于接下来想做什么，我希望继续把汽车、品牌和真实人物这些方向往深处做。也愿意遇到不熟悉的题目，先听明白，再找到它适合的表达。工作室可以有自己的审美，但不能拿同一个样子套所有客户。这是我想一直留住的工作习惯。

en.text: I want to go further into automotive work, brands and real people, while remaining open to unfamiliar subjects. A studio can have a point of view without giving every client the same treatment. That is the way of working I want RFG to keep.

zh-CN.text: 这个专栏会继续写。项目里的观察、设备的选择、照片为什么这样排、影片为什么这样剪，都可以慢慢拿出来聊。工作室还在变化，我也不想把介绍写成一个已经完成的结论。先把现在正在做的东西摆出来，让你看到一个具体的人和一间具体的工作室。

en.text: I want this column to keep developing. Observations from assignments, equipment choices, a sequence of photographs or a decision in an edit can all become part of it. The studio is still changing. For now, I would rather show the work in progress and the person behind it.

zh-CN.title: 车很好看，但我也想让你看到车旁边的人。
zh-CN.dek: 回看 SRO GT Cup 2025 平潭站的莲花车队照片，从赛车和维修区，读一场比赛里的协作。
zh-CN.pull_quote: 车是画面的中心，车旁边的人让这组照片有了故事。

en.title: The car looks good. I also want you to see the people beside it.
en.dek: Looking back at the Lotus team photographs from SRO GT Cup 2025 in Pingtan, through the track, the pit lane and the people.
en.pull_quote: The car draws the eye. The people beside it give the sequence a story.

zh-CN.text: 2025 年 6 月 28 日，SRO GT Cup 平潭站。这组莲花车队的照片，场景从赛道延伸到维修区。回看它们，我喜欢的不只是一辆赛车进入画面的样子，也包括车手、工程师和车辆被放在同一个现场里的关系。

en.text: 28 June 2025, SRO GT Cup in Pingtan. The Lotus team photographs move between the circuit and the pit lane. Looking back, I am drawn to the relationships between driver, engineer and vehicle as much as to the racing car itself.

zh-CN.caption: SRO GT Cup 2025 福建平潭站｜莲花车队纪实

en.caption: SRO GT Cup 2025 Pingtan — Lotus Team Documentary

zh-CN.text: 汽车本身很容易成为主角。车身的颜色、线条、号码和品牌标识都很明确，镜头一对过去，视觉重点就在那里。但只有这些，照片会更接近一组关于车的展示。我想留下的内容，还包括比赛是怎样被一群人共同完成的。

en.text: A car is a clear visual subject. Colour, lines, numbers and branding make it easy to locate the centre of a frame. On their own, those elements describe the vehicle. I also want the pictures to show the people working around it.

zh-CN.text: 所以维修区对这组作品很重要。它和赛道承担不同的信息：一个让人看到车在比赛里，另一个让人看到团队围绕这辆车工作。把两部分放在一起，车就有了前后文，人物也不再只是背景。

en.text: The pit lane matters to this sequence because it carries different information from the track. One shows the car racing; the other shows the team working with it. Together they give both the vehicle and the people a context.

zh-CN.text: 平潭的城市赛道又给照片增加了一层空间。赛车、团队和场地需要同时被看见。近景可以把注意力落到一个人或一个细节上，远景则提醒读者，这些事情发生在什么地方。

en.text: The Pingtan city circuit adds a sense of place. Close photographs can concentrate on a person or a detail, while wider ones remind us where the team and the cars are working.

zh-CN.text: 如果用这组照片介绍 RFG 的汽车拍摄，我希望你能读到两件事：我们会认真看车，也会认真看现场。品牌需要清楚地出现，比赛的关系和节奏也值得留下。两者放在同一组内容里，才有继续看的理由。

en.text: As an introduction to RFG automotive work, I want the sequence to show attention to the vehicle and to the occasion. The brand should be legible, and so should the relationships that make the event worth following.

zh-CN.text: 选片的时候，我也不想把它排成从头到尾都在冲刺的一组。车在赛道上是一种状态，围着车工作是另一种状态。把两种画面交替放，读者才有时间认出一辆车、一个人和他们所在的位置。一直把音量推到最大，反而容易把差别磨掉。

en.text: The sequence does not need to race at the same intensity from beginning to end. Cars on track and people working around them offer different states. Alternating those views gives the reader time to recognise a vehicle, a person and their place in the event.

zh-CN.text: 我对汽车的兴趣，也不止是最后那张漂亮的车身照片。一个品牌怎么出现，一支车队怎么被读到，一场比赛的地点有没有被记住，都值得放进去。这组作品里的黄色赛车很醒目，但我希望你往后翻，还会继续看旁边的东西。

en.text: My interest in cars extends beyond a polished body shot. The brand, the team and the location all have a part to play. The yellow cars make an immediate impression in this project; I hope the rest of the sequence gives you reasons to keep looking around them.

zh-CN.text: 对我来说，这也是赛车纪实有意思的地方。一辆车当然可以单独很好看；当你开始看它旁边的人，这组照片会变得更完整。

en.text: That is what holds my interest in motorsport photography. A car can make a strong picture by itself. Looking at the people beside it makes the record more complete.

zh-CN.title: 跟着导览走，也把目光留给展厅里的人。
zh-CN.dek: 浦东美术馆「少儿创艺之城」的影像里，有孩子共同创作的城市，也有真实的参观过程。
zh-CN.pull_quote: 观众听明白了，也愿意继续看，片子才成立。

en.title: Follow the guide. Keep looking at the people in the room.
en.dek: The Museum of Art Pudong film brings a city created by children together with the experience of visiting it.
en.pull_quote: The film needs to be understood, and it needs to keep people watching.

zh-CN.text: 浦东美术馆「少儿创艺之城」这支展览导览视频，给了我一个很具体的题目：怎样让一段介绍和一个真实的展览现场，出现在同一支片子里。影片从美术馆外景走进展厅，跟着导览展开，再进入作品和参观的细节。

en.text: The tour film for A Children’s Creative City at the Museum of Art Pudong poses a specific question: how can an explanation and a real exhibition share one film? The sequence moves from the museum exterior into the galleries, following the guide and then the work and its visitors.

zh-CN.caption: 浦东美术馆「少儿创艺之城」展览导览视频

en.caption: A Children’s Creative City — Museum Tour Film

zh-CN.text: 展览里的城市由儿童共同创作。模型、互动提案和现场体验，各自都有信息。只扫过一遍空间，观众未必知道该看哪里；如果每个镜头都只服务于说明，展厅又容易失去自己的气氛。

en.text: The city in the exhibition was created collaboratively by children. Models, interactive proposals and the visitor experience each carry information. A sweep across the room may not make that readable; explanation alone may lose the feeling of being there.

zh-CN.text: 我会把这支片子的线索理解成三条：导览带着信息向前走，作品细节给这些信息一个具体的样子，家庭和参与者让展览回到人的体验。镜头在它们之间切换，故事才会动起来。

en.text: I see three threads in the film. The guide moves the information forward. Details give that information a physical form. Families and participants bring it back to an experience. The sequence moves between them.

zh-CN.text: 照片和影片在这里也有区别。一张照片可以让人停下来自己看，影片还得考虑观看顺序。一个细节为什么放在这段讲述之后，下一镜要带去哪里，都影响观众能不能跟上。

en.text: Stills and film work differently here. A photograph lets the viewer pause and inspect. A film also needs an order: why a detail follows a particular explanation, and where the next shot takes us.

zh-CN.text: 这样的文化项目，是我希望 RFG 继续做的内容之一。它有自己的解释难度，也有视觉上的空间。我们需要认真理解题目，然后用画面把它讲清楚，让没到过现场的人也有一个进入的方式。

en.text: This is cultural work I want RFG to keep exploring. There is something to understand as well as something to photograph. The task is to give a person who has not visited a clear way into the exhibition.

zh-CN.text: 字幕也是画面的一部分。这支项目包含中英字幕，两种语言的长度不一样，换行和停留时间就要认真看。字幕不能把作品里值得看的细节盖住，也不能让观众一直忙着读字。我喜欢把它当成观看路径来处理，而不是在剪完以后随手补一层文字。

en.text: This project includes Chinese and English subtitles. Their different lengths make line breaks and reading time worth checking. Text should help the viewing path without covering the work or demanding all of the viewer’s attention. It belongs in the sequence, rather than being an afterthought.

zh-CN.text: 如果以后继续做这样的内容，我会先问：哪些信息必须准确交代，哪些部分可以让画面自己说。展览影片可以让人听懂介绍，也可以给人一点停下来看的时间。这个比例没有一个通用答案，得跟着具体的展览和这次要说的话去找。

en.text: For another exhibition film, I would start by asking which facts need a clear explanation and which moments can be carried by the images. There should be room both to understand and to look. The balance depends on the particular exhibition.

zh-CN.text: 再看这支影片，我觉得它最有意思的地方，还是作品和人的同时出现。展览有自己的内容，参观它的人又带来了新的动作和关系。把两边接起来，比只把一个空间拍漂亮更值得做。

en.text: Looking at the film again, what interests me is the presence of the work and the people together. The exhibition has its own content; visitors bring actions and relationships to it. Connecting the two gives the film something to follow.

zh-CN.alt_text: 浦东美术馆「少儿创艺之城」展览导览视频现场照片 01

en.alt_text: A Children’s Creative City — Museum Tour Film, photograph 01

zh-CN.title: 这组人像里，湖边也应该有它的位置。
zh-CN.dek: 2025 年 5 月 2 日的滴水湖跑步人像。回看光线、长影子和跑动的人，聊聊环境为什么要留在照片里。
zh-CN.pull_quote: 我想让你看到这个人，也看到她正在经过的地方。

en.title: The shoreline deserves a place in these portraits.
en.dek: The running portraits made at Dishui Lake on 2 May 2025: light, long shadows and a person moving through a place.
en.pull_quote: I want you to see the person and the place she is passing through.

zh-CN.text: 滴水湖这组清晨跑步人像，拍摄日期是 2025 年 5 月 2 日。照片里的元素很少：跑动的人、路面、湖水和远处的城市。低角度的光线让轮廓和影子变得明显，几样东西放在一起，就已经有了画面的方向。

en.text: The morning running portraits at Dishui Lake were made on 2 May 2025. They use a few elements: a moving person, the path, the water and the distant city. Low light gives the body and its shadow clear shapes.

zh-CN.caption: 滴水湖清晨跑步人像

en.caption: Morning Running Portraits at Dishui Lake

zh-CN.text: 回看这组照片，我很喜欢环境没有被退成一块模糊背景。湖岸线会带着视线走，影子和身体的动作又把视线拉回来。人物是重点，但这张照片为什么出现在滴水湖，也应该有一点回答。

en.text: Looking back, I like that the surroundings remain readable. The shoreline carries the eye through the picture; the body and its shadow bring it back. The person is the focus, and the place still has a role.

zh-CN.text: 跑步人像也有它自己的尺度。把人拍得很大，可以读到表情和动作；把距离放开，身体和空间之间的关系就会更清楚。我觉得两种画面都应该有，不然整组照片容易只有一个音量。

en.text: A closer portrait lets us read expression and movement. A little more distance shows the relationship between a body and its surroundings. I want a sequence to have both kinds of attention.

zh-CN.text: 这些照片里的跑动和短暂停顿，让我能从不同状态去看同一个人。动作不需要每张都到最夸张的位置。身体的方向、手的位置，以及画面里空出来的地方，都会影响照片的节奏。

en.text: Running and brief pauses offer different ways of looking at the same person. The movement does not need to be at its most dramatic in every frame. Direction, hands and open space all affect the rhythm.

zh-CN.text: 这组作品只有几张公开照片，也提醒我，数量和完成度并不是一回事。几张画面能不能有变化，能不能把这个人和这个地点留下来，比不断增加相似的照片更重要。

en.text: Only a few photographs from this assignment are public. A small set can still feel complete if the images offer different views of the person and the place. Adding similar pictures does not necessarily add anything.

zh-CN.text: 这里的竖幅也很重要。它让身体、湖岸和落在路面上的影子有一个上下的关系。我不想为了网站整齐，把影子或者身体截掉；也不想把照片放得巨大，让人翻了半天只看完一张。展示时给它合适的尺度，才是在认真对待这张照片。

en.text: The portrait orientation gives the body, the shoreline and the shadow a vertical relationship. Cropping them away for a tidy website would lose something. Making the image so large that it becomes difficult to browse would lose something else. The display scale matters.

zh-CN.text: 看完这一组，再看花艺人像或家庭照片，会发现我关心的东西有一些相通：人物有没有自己的状态，环境是不是和她有关系，画面里还有没有可以呼吸的地方。题目不同，这些问题可以一直问。

en.text: There are connections between these photographs, the floral portraits and the family work: the person’s own state, the relationship with the setting and the space around them. Different assignments can still be read through those questions.

zh-CN.text: 如果要用它解释我喜欢的人像方向，我会说：让人自然地待在一个地方，也让那个地方进入照片。最后看到的应该是一次具体的相遇，有人物，也有环境。

en.text: This is one portrait direction I like: a person at ease in a place, with that place allowed into the frame. The picture should keep something specific about both.

zh-CN.caption: 滴水湖清晨跑步人像 · 影像 03/04
zh-CN.alt_text: 滴水湖清晨跑步人像现场照片 03

en.caption: Morning Running Portraits at Dishui Lake · Image 03/04
en.alt_text: Morning Running Portraits at Dishui Lake, photograph 03

zh-CN.title: 房间里有一扇窗，就有很多可以看的东西。
zh-CN.dek: 回看书院民宿的空间照片：红墙、白色浴缸、窗外的屋顶，以及我为什么不想把每个房间都拍得无限大。
zh-CN.pull_quote: 我希望照片让人想进去，也知道自己要走进什么地方。

en.title: A window gives a room plenty to say.
en.dek: The Shuyuan interiors: a red wall, a white bathtub, roofs outside the window and why the widest view is not always the most useful.
en.pull_quote: I want a photograph to invite you in, and to show what you are walking into.

zh-CN.text: 书院民宿这组空间照片里，有一张我愿意多看一会儿：左边是红色的墙，白色浴缸靠在窗前，右边有黑色的座椅和落地灯。窗外还能看到树、屋顶和电线。这些东西并不都很“干净”，但它们放在一起，房间就有了具体的位置。

en.text: One Shuyuan photograph rewards a longer look. A red wall sits on the left, a white bathtub beside the window, and a dark seat and floor lamp on the right. Trees, roofs and wires remain visible outside. Together they locate the room in an actual place.

zh-CN.caption: 书院民宿空间摄影

en.caption: Shuyuan Guesthouse Interior Photography

zh-CN.text: 我觉得空间摄影很容易被一个目标带走：要宽，要亮，要显得很大。这样拍当然有它的用途，但房间里的关系也容易被挤平。浴缸离窗有多近，床和座椅之间留了多少地方，这些比单纯把四个角都塞进照片里更值得交代。

en.text: It is easy to make width, brightness and apparent size the only goals of an interior photograph. Those choices have uses, but they can flatten the room’s relationships. The distance between the bathtub and the window, or the bed and the seat, is worth making readable.

zh-CN.text: 这张照片里的光线是斜着进来的。红墙上有一块更亮的形状，窗帘和地板也有明暗变化。我喜欢这些地方，因为它们告诉你这个房间在白天会是什么样子。把所有暗部都提到同一个亮度，空间反而会变得没有层次。

en.text: Light enters this frame at an angle. There is a brighter shape on the red wall and a change of tone across the curtain and the floor. Those differences suggest what daytime in the room is like. Raising every shadow to the same level would take away its depth.

zh-CN.text: 窗外也不必每次都退成一整块白色。能读到一点外面的环境，室内就和周围接上了。当然，窗景不能抢走所有注意力。对我来说，它应该像房间的一部分，提醒你这里有光、有天气，也有屋子以外的生活。

en.text: The window does not always need to become a blank white area. A little of the exterior connects the room with its surroundings. It should not take over the photograph, but it can remind us of light, weather and life beyond the interior.

zh-CN.text: 看整组作品，客房、公共区域、软装和外观各有各的作用。主图先让人理解一个空间，细节再补上触感和颜色。一张灯具或者布料的照片可以很漂亮，但前后需要有房间把它接住，否则就很难知道它属于哪里。

en.text: The rooms, shared areas, furnishings and exterior each have a role in the set. A wider view explains a space; details add texture and colour. A lamp or a fabric photograph becomes more useful when the surrounding sequence lets us see where it belongs.

zh-CN.text: 后期也应该照顾这些关系。墙面的颜色、白色家具的层次、窗边亮部是不是还自然，都要放在一起看。我想保留房间自己的性格，不能让每一种材质最后都变成同一层光滑的表面。

en.text: The edit should keep those relationships intact. Wall colour, detail in pale furniture and the light by the window need to be considered together. Different materials should remain distinct rather than taking on the same polished surface.

zh-CN.text: 客户最后把它放到网站或住宿介绍里，读者常常是在手机上看。先看到一个完整空间，再看到细节，会比一开始就铺很多相近的角度更好理解。所以选片和展示顺序，也算空间拍摄的一部分。

en.text: On a website or a listing, many people will first see the room on a phone. A clear overall view followed by details is easier to understand than several near-identical angles at once. Selection and display order are part of showing the space.

zh-CN.text: 我希望这种照片能让人想走进去，同时对这个地方有一个可信的预期。房间够好看，已经值得认真拍了。没有必要再把它变成另一个不存在的房间。

en.text: I want these photographs to make someone interested in visiting, with a believable expectation of the place. The room has enough character to deserve attention as it is.

zh-CN.caption: 书院民宿空间摄影 · 影像 04/13
zh-CN.alt_text: 书院民宿空间摄影现场照片 04

en.caption: Shuyuan Guesthouse Interior Photography · Image 04/13
en.alt_text: Shuyuan Guesthouse Interior Photography, photograph 04

zh-CN.title: 花已经很热闹了，人可以松一点。
zh-CN.dek: 花小念这组形象照片里，花材、牛仔服和暖色的房间放在一起。聊聊品牌照片为什么还需要一个真实的人。
zh-CN.pull_quote: 我希望你先觉得这个画面有意思，再愿意认识它背后的人。

en.title: The flowers are expressive. The person can take it easy.
en.dek: Flowers, denim and a warm-toned room in the Huaxiaonian portraits, and the place of a real person in a brand image.
en.pull_quote: I hope the picture catches your attention, then makes you curious about the person behind it.

zh-CN.text: 花小念这组照片，有一个很直观的对比。花的颜色和形状很多，人物穿的是牛仔服，墙面和地板又比较暖。大束花已经把画面撑起来了，人坐在旁边，不需要再用一个特别用力的姿势证明自己是主角。

en.text: There is a clear contrast in the Huaxiaonian portraits. The arrangement has many colours and shapes; the person wears denim, against a warm wall and floor. The flowers give the frame a strong presence. The person beside them does not need an emphatic pose.

zh-CN.caption: 花小念花艺形象拍摄

en.caption: Huaxiaonian Floral Brand Portraits

zh-CN.text: 我喜欢这种轻一点的状态。看向镜头是一张照片，侧过头看向别处又是另一张。它们没有必要被统一成同一个表情。人物有一点自己的空间，画面会更像某个人在某个房间里，而不是一个品牌模板换了名字。

en.text: I like the ease of those different states. Looking into the camera and looking away make different photographs. There is no need to reduce them to one expression. A little room for the person helps the picture stay specific.

zh-CN.text: 花材也要能看清楚。高一些的线条往上走，中间有密集的颜色，边缘又有伸出去的叶片。拍整束的时候看的是体量和轮廓，靠近的时候看的是层次。两种距离放在一组里，才不会只剩一团好看的颜色。

en.text: The arrangement needs to be legible too. Taller stems lead upward, colour gathers in the middle and leaves extend at the edges. A wider view shows its scale and shape; a closer one shows the layers. Both distances are useful in the set.

zh-CN.text: 人物在这里还给了花一个尺度。单独看花，有时候不知道它到底有多大；旁边坐了一个人，就能很快读到它的体量。但我不希望人只承担一把尺子的作用。她的衣服、姿态和表情，也在影响这组照片的气质。

en.text: A person helps us read the scale of the flowers immediately. But she should have more to do than provide a measurement. Clothes, posture and expression also shape the character of these photographs.

zh-CN.text: 如果把背景、服装、花材的颜色都推得很满，画面很容易互相抢。我更愿意让它们各有位置：花有花的细节，牛仔服有自己的质地，房间安静一点，把两者接住。品牌的识别度可以从这种关系里出来。

en.text: Colour in the flowers, clothes and setting can easily compete. I prefer each to have a place: detail in the arrangement, texture in the denim and a quieter room holding the two together. That relationship can give a brand image its character.

zh-CN.text: 这组以竖幅为主的照片，也适合聊展示。竖图的上下关系很完整，人物、花和台面都在里面。换到网站上，不应该为了塞进一个横框，把这些东西裁掉。照片之间可以并排，但每一张仍然要有自己的完整边界。

en.text: These mostly vertical frames keep the relationship between the person, the flowers and the table. A website should not crop that away simply to fill a landscape box. Images can sit alongside each other while remaining complete.

zh-CN.text: 我想做的品牌摄影，既能交代产品，也让人感到这是某个人认真做出来的东西。花艺尤其如此，作品本身就有很多选择：颜色怎么配，形状怎么展开，最后摆在哪里。照片可以把这些选择留得具体一点。

en.text: The brand photographs I want to make should describe the work and allow us to sense someone making it. Floral work contains many choices of colour, shape and placement. A photograph can keep those choices visible.

zh-CN.text: 所以这组照片对我来说，不只是“花拍得很漂亮”。它还有人和房间，也有一个不那么端着的状态。我觉得这个状态很重要。让人愿意靠近，有时比把一切都摆得非常正式更有效。

en.text: For me, this set is about more than attractive flowers. There is a person, a room and an unforced way of being in them. That ease can make someone want to look more closely.

zh-CN.caption: 花小念花艺形象拍摄 · 影像 02/09
zh-CN.alt_text: 花小念花艺形象拍摄现场照片 02

en.caption: Huaxiaonian Floral Brand Portraits · Image 02/09
en.alt_text: Huaxiaonian Floral Brand Portraits, photograph 02

zh-CN.title: 一场活动拍完，要让没来的人也看明白。
zh-CN.dek: 从上海中医药大学 × 玉森制药的学术活动，到中船动力的企业纪实，聊聊我怎么理解“完整交付”。
zh-CN.pull_quote: 客户拿到的应该是一组可以用的内容，而不只是一堆照片。

en.title: An event record should make sense to someone who was not there.
en.dek: The Shanghai University of TCM × Yusen Pharma event and the CSSC Power record offer a practical way to talk about a complete delivery.
en.pull_quote: The client should receive a usable set, rather than just a large number of files.

zh-CN.text: 上海中医药大学 × 玉森制药这组活动照片里，发言的人、报告的背景和坐着听的人都在同一个空间里。红色屏幕很醒目，但画面要交代的并不只有这个颜色。谁在讲、讲述发生在哪里、现场是什么状态，几件事都得让人看得懂。

en.text: The Shanghai University of TCM × Yusen Pharma photographs place speakers, presentation material and listeners in one room. The red screen is prominent, but the record has more to explain: the speaking situation, the place and the people listening.

zh-CN.caption: 上海中医药大学 × 玉森制药学术活动

en.caption: Shanghai University of TCM × Yusen Pharma Academic Event

zh-CN.text: 这样的项目，我会先把“不能漏”想清楚。发言、报告、交流、整体会场，各自承担一部分信息。某个环节照片多，不能替代另一个环节没有被记录。看作品的时候我也会用这个标准，先确认内容完整，再讨论哪些照片最适合放在前面。

en.text: For a project like this, I would first define what needs to be covered. Speeches, reports, conversations and room views carry different information. More photographs from one part cannot compensate for a missing part. Completeness gives the selection a basis.

zh-CN.text: 发言照片也不是只要眼睛睁着就够了。手势、嘴型、面前的讲台、背景上的文字，都会影响它好不好用。构图可以有变化，但不应该为了一个夸张的角度，让人和活动信息都变得难以阅读。

en.text: A useful speaker photograph involves more than open eyes. Gesture, expression, the lectern and the background text all matter. Different compositions are welcome, provided the person and the event remain readable.

zh-CN.text: 听众和交流的画面，能把一场活动从一张舞台照片里展开。它让人看到，内容是怎样被接收的，人和人怎样在这个地方遇到。前后放在一起，现场就有了来回，也不至于一直重复一个人站在台上的样子。

en.text: Listeners and conversations extend the record beyond the stage. They show how the occasion is received and how people meet within it. Those views give the sequence a movement between the presentation and the room.

zh-CN.text: 中船动力的那组又多了揭牌、培训、技术参观和合影。项目不同，要交代的关系也不同。我不希望把每一次企业拍摄都做成相同的几个动作。先读懂这次活动在做什么，照片的重点才会跟着变化。

en.text: The CSSC Power record includes an unveiling, training, a technical visit and group photographs. A different programme calls for a different emphasis. Understanding this particular occasion gives the images their structure.

zh-CN.text: 交付时，我觉得有两个尺度要同时成立。挑出来的照片要足够清楚，适合做活动回顾；整组又要留下可供继续使用的内容。客户写公众号、做汇报或更新网站，需要的画面不完全一样。用途说清楚，选片就不必靠猜。

en.text: The delivery has two scales. A selected sequence should explain the event clearly, while the fuller set gives the client material for later use. A WeChat recap, a presentation and a website update may need different views. Knowing those uses helps the selection.

zh-CN.text: 文件整理也是交付的一部分。把不同环节放在合理的顺序里，让人找到想用的画面，听起来不够浪漫，但真的很重要。再好的照片，如果对方要反复翻半天才能找到，工作也没有结束得特别好。

en.text: File organisation belongs to delivery as well. A sensible sequence makes it easier to locate a useful picture. It may not be the most romantic part of photography, but an image is less helpful if someone has to keep searching for it.

zh-CN.text: 我希望 RFG 在活动影像这件事上，既有审美，也能让人放心。漂亮的照片值得留下，清楚的记录也值得认真做。最后把它交给一个没到过现场的人，他仍然能顺着看懂，这组内容就有了实际的价值。

en.text: I want RFG event work to have a point of view and to be dependable. Strong pictures matter, as does a clear record. If someone who was not there can follow the set, it is doing useful work.

zh-CN.title: 合影拍完，生活还在继续。
zh-CN.dek: 从百日宴的照片里，看抱孩子的手、窗边的光和亲友之间的关系。私人纪实里，一些小动作值得留下。
zh-CN.pull_quote: 有些照片不需要告诉你该感动，它只是把人好好留下来。

en.title: After the group photograph, life carries on.
en.dek: Hands holding a baby, window light and relationships between family members in the 100-day celebration photographs.
en.pull_quote: Some photographs simply keep a person and a relationship, without telling you how to feel.

zh-CN.text: 百日宴这组照片里，有一张窗边的肖像：妈妈坐着，孩子在怀里，手还放在孩子身上。她看着镜头，孩子没有。这个不同步的状态，我觉得很好。照片不用让每个人都同时配合，关系也已经在里面了。

en.text: In one window-side portrait from the 100-day celebration, the mother sits with her baby in her arms and a hand resting beside the child. She looks at the camera; the baby does not. Their different states already give the picture a relationship.

zh-CN.caption: 百日宴家庭纪实

en.caption: Baby's 100-Day Family Documentary

zh-CN.text: 拍这种题目，正式合影当然要有。它交代了谁和谁在一起，也有很明确的纪念作用。但整组照片如果只有大家排好看镜头，回看时会少一点当天的生活。照料、陪伴和亲友之间的互动，可以把那一部分补回来。

en.text: Formal group photographs have a clear purpose: they keep a record of people together. A fuller sequence can also include care, companionship and interaction, giving some of the day’s ordinary life a place beside the posed pictures.

zh-CN.text: 孩子并不需要知道拍摄流程，也不会按我们的计划给表情。我更愿意把这个当成照片里的真实条件。大人在照顾，孩子有自己的状态，摄影师要跟着看，而不是要求所有事情都为了镜头重新发生一次。

en.text: A baby has no reason to follow a photographic plan. Adults are caring for the child, and the child has a state of their own. Those are the conditions of the picture. I would rather pay attention to them than ask for everything to happen again for the camera.

zh-CN.text: 抱孩子的手有时候比一个完整的笑脸更能说明关系。谁在扶，谁靠得近，身体向着谁，这些小地方都值得看。它们未必是最显眼的照片，却会让一组家庭纪实里的人不只是一个名字。

en.text: Hands, distance and the direction of a body can tell us a lot. Who is supporting the child? Who leans closer? Those small details give family members a presence beyond their names in a group photograph.

zh-CN.text: 窗边的光也适合这种状态。亮的地方把人物带出来，室内的颜色还留在后面。不需要每一张都变成很强的戏剧光。我希望看到的是人和当时的环境，而不是后期给所有照片加上的同一种情绪。

en.text: Window light suits that quiet attention. It brings the person forward while keeping the room behind them. Every image does not need a dramatic treatment; the people and their surroundings can carry the photograph.

zh-CN.text: 这样的照片以后可能会被一家人反复看。今天觉得很普通的一个动作，过几年也许会变得很具体：原来那时是这样抱的，原来她坐在这里。照片的价值不一定在拍完当天就全部显出来，所以我也想给平常的部分留位置。

en.text: A family may return to these photographs over time. An ordinary gesture can later become very specific: how a child was held, where someone sat. The value of a picture is not always fully apparent on the day it is made.

zh-CN.text: 公开展示又是另一件事。我希望网站只使用已经确认可以公开的那部分素材，让人理解我们的拍摄方向就够了。私人活动不是为了给工作室提供无穷无尽的内容。家人的记忆应该先属于他们。

en.text: Showing the work publicly is a separate decision. The website should stay within the confirmed public selection, with enough to explain our approach. A private occasion is not an unlimited source of studio content. The family’s record belongs with them first.

zh-CN.text: 我也喜欢拍汽车和品牌，但这些比较安静的题目值得同时留在 RFG 里。它们提醒我，摄影有时不用把事情说得特别大。把一个人、一个动作和旁边的人好好拍下来，已经很有内容了。

en.text: I like automotive and brand work, and I want these quieter subjects to remain part of RFG as well. Photography can hold a person, a gesture and someone beside them without needing a grand subject.

zh-CN.title: Vivienne Westwood Café｜前滩太古里开业
zh-CN.summary: 为上海前滩太古里 Vivienne Westwood 新店开业拍摄 Café 空间、品牌标识与陈设细节，记录咖啡吧台及英伦街景主题装置。
zh-CN.story:
这次前滩太古里新店开业拍摄，我把 Vivienne Westwood Café 单独整理成一组。先看咖啡吧台，再看标识、菜单和台面上的用品。把这些放在一起，才看得清这间 Café 的具体样子。

红色电话亭、邮筒和巴士站主题陈设，把英伦街景带进了店内。它们有很强的识别度，但这组照片也留下了吧台本身：咖啡店不只有适合拍照的装置，还有点单、制作和陈列的空间。

这套开业照片里还有店铺空镜和产品静物。我选择把三个主题拆开，让读者能分别看空间、Café 和柜内产品；它们来自同一次拍摄，放回一起也能串起完整的新店记录。

背景资料：前滩太古里的开放式街区，把零售、餐饮与公共空间放在同一条步行路径上。咖啡、陈设与店铺空镜共同记录品牌在日常空间中的呈现。

en.title: Vivienne Westwood Café — Opening at Taikoo Li Qiantan
en.summary: Photography for the opening of Vivienne Westwood at Taikoo Li Qiantan in Shanghai, documenting the Café counter, branding, display details and British streetscape installation.
en.story:
For the new-store opening at Taikoo Li Qiantan, I have given the Vivienne Westwood Café its own series. The sequence starts with the counter, then moves to signage, menus and counter accessories. Together, these views describe the Café at different scales.

A red telephone box, postbox and bus-stop installation bring a British street setting into the store. They are distinctive elements, but the counter remains part of the story too: the Café is also a space arranged around ordering, preparation and display.

The same shoot includes retail interiors and product still lifes. I have separated the three subjects so each can be viewed in its own right. Read together, they make a fuller record of the new store.

Background: Taikoo Li Qiantan brings retail, dining and public space together in an open-air precinct. The café, displays and store interiors document the brand within an everyday setting.

zh-CN.title: Vivienne Westwood｜前滩太古里店铺空镜
zh-CN.summary: 为上海前滩太古里 Vivienne Westwood 新店拍摄店铺空镜，以门头、室内全景、休息区与陈列细节呈现零售空间。
zh-CN.story:
这一篇接着前滩 Café，往店铺里面走。门头交代入口，室内全景交代柜台、通道和陈列的位置。我把这些画面留在一组里，方便先理解空间，再看里面的东西。

弧形展示柜、镜面墙体和沙发休息区，是这套空镜里的几个重点。镜面会把陈列和空间重复带进画面，柜台的弧线又改变了观看方向。全景和局部各有用途，不能只用一种距离看完整间店。

服装、包袋、眼镜、围巾和腰带都在各自的陈列位置上。这篇保留它们与店铺的关系，珠宝和腕表则另放进产品篇。这样看空镜的时候，视线不会总被某一件产品带走。

背景资料：前滩太古里的开放式街区，把零售、餐饮与公共空间放在同一条步行路径上。咖啡、陈设与店铺空镜共同记录品牌在日常空间中的呈现。

en.title: Vivienne Westwood — Store Interiors at Taikoo Li Qiantan
en.summary: Retail space photography of the new Vivienne Westwood store at Taikoo Li Qiantan in Shanghai, covering the storefront, interior views, seating area and merchandise displays.
en.story:
This series continues beyond the Qiantan Café into the retail space. The storefront establishes the entrance; wider interior views show the counters, circulation and displays. I have kept these photographs together so the layout can be understood before its details.

Curved display counters, mirrored walls and the seating area are key parts of the series. Mirrors repeat the displays and the room, while the curves of the counters change the viewing direction. Wider frames and closer details describe different aspects of the interior.

Clothing, bags, eyewear, scarves and belts appear in their display settings. This article keeps those relationships with the room intact, while jewellery and watches receive a separate product story.

Background: Taikoo Li Qiantan brings retail, dining and public space together in an open-air precinct. The café, displays and store interiors document the brand within an everyday setting.

zh-CN.title: Vivienne Westwood｜珠宝与腕表静物摄影
zh-CN.summary: 在上海前滩太古里 Vivienne Westwood 新店开业拍摄中，以柜内静物和局部特写记录珠宝、珍珠饰品与腕表的陈列细节。
zh-CN.story:
前滩新店开业的第三个主题，是珠宝与腕表。这组是在现场展示柜里完成的静物摄影。我把组合陈列、俯拍和单件特写放在一起，既交代产品的排列，也留下每件东西的细节。

Orb 标识、珍珠饰品、表盘和金属表带，各自需要不同的观看距离。整柜画面能看出系列，近一点才看得见标识、轮廓和材质。玻璃反射与柜内灯光也留在照片里，说明它们当时是怎样被展示的。

我把它单列为产品篇，是因为看产品和看店铺的重点确实不同。这里不需要把整间店重新讲一遍，注意力就放在这些小物件，以及它们在柜台里形成的组合上。

背景资料：Westwood 的 Orb 标志把王权宝球与土星环结合，延续品牌将传统带向未来的想法。标志、珠宝与装饰细节，是这组影像中反复出现的视觉线索。

en.title: Vivienne Westwood — Jewellery and Watch Still Life
en.summary: Still-life and detail photography of jewellery, pearl accessories and watches, photographed in display cases for the opening of Vivienne Westwood at Taikoo Li Qiantan in Shanghai.
en.story:
Jewellery and watches form the third part of the Qiantan store-opening shoot. These still lifes were photographed in the display cases. Collection views, overhead compositions and individual close-ups show both the arrangements and the details of each piece.

Orb motifs, pearl accessories, watch dials and metal bracelets invite different viewing distances. Collection frames describe the range; closer photographs reveal the motifs, shapes and materials. Glass reflections and display lighting retain the context of the store.

I have made this a separate product story because its focus differs from the interior series. The attention here stays with the small objects and the combinations they form inside the cases.

Background: Westwood’s Orb combines a royal orb with a Saturn-like ring, reflecting the house’s idea of taking tradition into the future. Emblems, jewellery and decorative details recur throughout this series.

zh-CN.title: Gerald Charles｜招商银行私人银行制表文化讲座
zh-CN.summary: 与美时维工坊合作，在招商银行私人银行举办制表文化系列讲座，围绕 Gerald Charles 的品牌历史与制表知识展开分享，记录讲座现场、腕表展示和陈设细节。
zh-CN.story:
这次与美时维工坊合作，在招商银行私人银行举办制表文化系列讲座。内容围绕 Gerald Charles 的品牌历史与制表知识展开，我记录了讲者、听众、腕表展示和现场陈设。

在这组照片里，讲座和产品展示是连着的。讲者与听众的画面交代交流，展示桌、表盘和多色表带则把讲座涉及的对象具体呈现出来。只有会场全景，或者只有腕表特写，都不足以说明这次活动。

专栏里我把这两条线交替放在一起。读者可以先看人在讲什么样的活动，再靠近看腕表；这里记录的是讲座与展示现场，不把它写成没有依据的产品评测。

背景资料：Gerald Charles 由 Gérald Charles Genta 于 2000 年创立。以设计师原始草图为延续的品牌脉络，为这场制表文化讲座提供了清晰的设计背景。
services: 腕表展示及陈设细节摄影

en.title: Gerald Charles — Watchmaking Culture Lecture at China Merchants Bank Private Banking
en.summary: A watchmaking culture lecture jointly organised with Meishiwei Workshop at China Merchants Bank Private Banking, exploring Gerald Charles brand history and watchmaking through lecture coverage, watch displays and event details.
en.story:
This watchmaking-culture lecture was organised with Treasure Care at China Merchants Bank Private Banking. The programme covered Gerald Charles brand history and watchmaking knowledge; my photographs document the speakers, audience, watches and display setting.

The lecture and the product displays belong to the same record. Speaker and audience photographs show the exchange, while tables, dials and coloured straps give the discussion a visible subject. Neither venue views nor watch close-ups alone describe the whole event.

I have interwoven those two strands here, moving from the lecture setting to closer views of the watches. This is a record of the event and its displays, rather than a product review.

Background: Founded by Gérald Charles Genta in 2000, Gerald Charles continues a design lineage rooted in his original drawings. That history provides context for this watchmaking-culture lecture.
services: Watch display and event detail photography

zh-CN.title: Brand SA｜上海浦东丽晶酒店南非社群交流活动
zh-CN.summary: 在上海浦东丽晶酒店记录与 Brand SA 合作的南非社群交流活动，涵盖现场布置、嘉宾发言、证书颁授、来宾交流与合影。
zh-CN.story:
这次在上海浦东丽晶酒店，记录与 Brand SA 合作的南非社群交流活动。Global South Africans Network 的现场展示、嘉宾发言、证书颁授和来宾合影，构成了这组照片的主要内容。

正式环节之外，还有来宾之间的交流。人物特写和合影会给出不同的信息：一张看表情与手势，另一张看谁和谁站在一起。整理这组照片时，我把空间、流程和交流画面都留了下来。

这场拍摄启用了索尼 FE 50–150mm F2 GM，整理的十张照片中有六张以这支镜头的 F2 光圈拍摄。照片里的前后景层次可以直接看，器材信息放在这里作为这次拍摄的记录，不替代对现场的描述。

背景资料：Brand South Africa 通过 Global South Africans 等倡议连接海外南非社群。在上海的交流现场，人物之间的距离与谈话构成画面的主要线索。

嘉宾发言、证书颁授与社群交流
